zotero.abstractNote: Systems and methods are provided for estimating subject pose and shape. In some examples, the method includes generating, by an image encoder, a structured representation for an image; mapping, by a prompt encoder, a plurality of types of prompts associated with the image to a plurality of prompt tokens; and estimating, by using a transformer-based computing model, a set of subject parameters based at least in part on the structured representation and the plurality of prompt tokens. In some examples, the plurality of types of prompts includes a first type of prompts having a first modality and a second type of prompts having a second modality different from the first modality.
